title: Result of channel.put
description: Request args: {"slot": n, "name": 1 to 31 bytes, "secret": 32 hex digits (a 128-bit key, as the native CMD_SET_CHANNEL frame), "favourite": true or false, optional}. With no favourite given, the slot keeps its mark when the same key is written again and is off when the slot gets a different channel; a value given always wins. A key that another slot already holds is failed with error duplicate-secret; an all-zero key is invalid; a table that cannot be saved is failed with error write-failed and the slot is left as it was. The secret is written, never read back. Companion only.

hash.description: The channel hash on air: the first byte of SHA-256 of the key.

replaced.description: True when the slot held a channel before.

favourite.description: True when this slot's messages notify the device's screen and buzzer. Off for every slot unless set; the same channel written again keeps it; a different channel or a removal clears it.
